title: 中国AI实验室转向OpenAI的Astra模型，Anthropic加强防御应对
originalTitle: OpenAI's Astra becomes the main target for Chinese AI labs after Anthropic tightens its defenses
summary: 中国AI实验室转向OpenAI的Astra模型，Anthropic通过新方法将数据泄露风险降低90%-99%。OpenAI被指与Moonshot合作进行协同蒸馏攻击，但尚未回应具体指控。

author: Maximilian Schreiner
